ideas.pitch: Multimodal satellite crop monitoring and early disease detection platform tailored for smallholder farmers in Karnataka, featuring local language voice agents.
ideas.title: KannadaAgriSense
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages satellite monitoring and localized multi-agent AI, mirroring the winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS and greennovation-ai-platform while targeting regional agricultural impact highly relevant to RVCE/RVITM judges.

ideas.pitch: Real-time commuter bottleneck prediction and dynamic congestion mitigation dashboard built specifically for Bengaluru's urban transit challenges.
ideas.title: NammaTrafficGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles a high-pain localized problem using graph intelligence and predictive modeling inspired by Bito's winning architecture, delivering immense practical impact for local judges.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven skill gap analyzer and interactive roadmap generator connecting local engineering college curricula directly with industrial skill requirements in Karnataka.
ideas.title: EduSkillPath Karnataka
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the higher education and student innovation ecosystem that organizers from RVCE and RVITM care deeply about, backed by a polished multi-agent retrieval system.

ideas.pitch: IoT-linked reservoir and water quality tracking platform predicting contamination and drought risks across Karnataka river basins days in advance.
ideas.title: AquaReserve Karnataka
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on the predictive environmental approach of iForeSea-AquaSense-IoT-Hackathon, combining hard data modeling with a live operational dashboard.

ideas.pitch: Multilingual clinical simulation and emergency triage copilot designed for rural healthcare workers in Karnataka, featuring symptom scoring and voice input.
ideas.title: MedTriage Kannada
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines healthcare utility with rigorous rubric scoring and voice interfaces, echoing the grand-prize-winning execution pattern of Clinical-Simulator.
